facts.fact: 叙述者断言抽象表现主义是 CIA 人员 Tom Braden 发明的，而非 Pollock 那批画家。
facts.anchor: Abstract Expressionism was invented by a CIA guy called Tom Braden.

facts.fact: Braden 向富有的老朋友 Peggy Guggenheim 求助。
facts.anchor: Braden called in a favor from his rich old friend Peggy Guggenheim

facts.fact: Guggenheim 毫不犹豫地推荐了 Jackson Pollock。
facts.anchor: her reply, without hesitation, was “Jackson Pollock.”

facts.fact: 1946 年 1 月 14 日星期一上午，Braden 在 Pollock 的画室意外发明了抽象表现主义。
facts.anchor: Braden accidentally invented Abstract Expressionism on Monday morning, January 14th, 1946

facts.fact: Braden 进门时看到 Pollock 坐在地上，用剪刀剪开几十个鸡蛋盒做毛毛虫。
facts.anchor: using scissors to cut apart dozens of egg cartons

facts.fact: Braden 为稳住身体撞上桌子，撞翻了几罐打开的颜料。
facts.anchor: he smashed right into several open cans of paint

facts.fact: 颜料溅满画布，现场一片混乱，叙述者却称之为辉煌。
facts.anchor: It was chaos. It was a royal mess. It was glorious.

facts.fact: 1951 年初，成百上千幅抽象表现主义原作神秘出现在苏联各地。
facts.anchor: The how and the when came in early 1951
